name: 85714 · Tucson, AZ
findings: ZIP 85714 (Tucson) has 31 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85714 (Tucson) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 85714 (Tucson) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 16% of all organizations here have no identified type.
